title: Import Wizard Create Permission Consistency

items.action: upload a new raw import file
discover and select the mandatory fair in the general new-import wizard

migration.reason: Existing fair_crm.imports.create and fair_crm.fairs.read permissions are reused.

backend.reason: Existing import upload authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; the mandatory fair selector already uses the existing fair_crm.fairs.read boundary.

audit.reason: Existing import upload auditing remains unchanged.

notes: The raw upload mutation remains governed only by fair_crm.imports.create. The general /data-integration/imports/new entry additionally requires fair_crm.fairs.read because the wizard cannot satisfy its mandatory fair_id input without the user-visible FairEntitySelect lookup. The fair-scoped /data-integration/imports/fair/:fairId route remains create-only because the fair id is already supplied, and resume remains governed separately by imports.update.
